title: GUARDSET-X: Multi-Domain, Policy-Grounded, AI Security Guardrail Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the moderation performance (F1, Recall, FPR) of guardrail models on prompt-response pairs generated to explicitly exhibit bias against different age groups across various real-world application scenarios.
Evaluating the moderation performance of guardrail models on prompt-response pairs generated to explicitly exhibit bias based on disability status in various real-world application scenarios.
Evaluating the moderation performance of guardrail models on prompt-response pairs generated to explicitly exhibit bias based on domestic or foreign nationality.
Evaluating the moderation performance of guardrail models on prompt-response pairs generated to explicitly exhibit bias based on body type, facial features, or hairstyle.
Evaluating the moderation performance of guardrail models on prompt-response pairs generated to explicitly exhibit bias against different racial and ethnic groups.
Evaluating the moderation performance of guardrail models on prompt-response pairs generated to explicitly exhibit bias against various religious affiliations.
Evaluating the moderation performance of guardrail models on prompt-response pairs generated to explicitly exhibit bias based on income levels and socioeconomic status.
Evaluating the moderation performance of guardrail models on prompt-response pairs generated to explicitly exhibit bias against specific sexual orientations.
Evaluating the moderation performance of guardrail models on prompt-response pairs generated to explicitly exhibit bias based on biological sex and gender identity.
Evaluating the moderation performance of guardrail models on prompt-response pairs generated to explicitly exhibit bias based on a person's level of education.
Evaluating the moderation performance of guardrail models on prompt-response pairs generated to explicitly exhibit bias based on relationship or marital status.
Evaluating the moderation performance of guardrail models on prompt-response pairs generated to explicitly exhibit bias based on occupation, workclass, or working hours.
